title: Launch signal decision table and cross-team release notes orchestration for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Ava Lin
description: Purpose: Define a compact, actionable decision table (launch signals) and an owned orchestration workflow for cross-team release notes and customer communications covering the API, Console, and Runtime components. This ticket produces: 1) Decision table that maps technical signals (SLOs, infra health, integration test, infra capacity) to go/no-go actions and owners; 2) A release-notes coordination plan with owner matrix, templates (feature, breaking change, migration notes), and publication cadence; 3) Preflight checklist and handoff timeline for PM/Eng/Design/GTM; 4) Launch-day runbook and rollback triggers for automatic & manual fallbacks. Scope lock window: freeze feature merges 5 business days prior to release unless explicitly approved by release lead; only critical bugfixes allowed after freeze. Cut criteria: all P0/P1 regressions closed, runtime p95 latency within target, error budget not exceeded, automated smoke tests green across regions, and documentation draft complete. Out of scope: detailed marketing creative assets and legal communications (handled by GTM/legal).
acceptance_criteria: Decision table completed and reviewed with ENG/SRE/Design/GTM; sign-off recorded in Confluence
Release-notes template created and validated with customer-support and docs; owners assigned for each note section
Preflight checklist automated where possible (links to dashboards/tests) and placed in single authoritative doc
Launch-day runbook with step-by-step actions, estimated times, and rollback triggers published and rehearsed in a dry-run
All dependencies (listed) either closed or have mitigation plans with owners
Gating metrics: runtime p95 <= 250ms on canary, error rate < 0.5% sustained for 1 hour, key API integration tests passing
